title: Work windows count only a worker's own session
goal: A work window opens from a work/<id> branch only for that item's worker session and closes with the item, so backlog.py cost never counts an orchestrator's or a stale checkout's prompts on an item; land's no-work-rows warning reads branch rows; the docs describe claim and branch windows and no longer cite BG-maqf3lxh as open; checks and repros run with an isolated query log home, so none writes to the clone's spool; and kb-sprint plan asks that a new attribution rule's checks cover a session that must not be attributed

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
